name: tr_gp2
caption:
IF GP2 HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🥊 Hitmonchan: punches too fast to see. Son of Hall of Famer Gary Payton, the Glove. He goes by Young Glove
🕷️ Spidops: it takes out prey before it notices. 2x Pac-12 Defensive Player of the Year at Oregon State
🐛 Nincada: it waits underground for years to evolve. Undrafted in 2016, then G League Defensive Player of the Year in 2021
🧂 Garganacl: its salt heals even severe wounds. 2022 playoffs: a fractured elbow against Memphis
🐬 Palafin: it powers up when its allies need it. Back for the Finals: 15 points and 3 steals in Game 5
⚡ Pawmot: lightning fast once the battle starts. Undrafted, then a champion with us in 2022

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Gary Payton the second had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF GP2 HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Hitmonchan. Its punches are so fast, no one can see them. His dad is Hall of Famer Gary Payton, the Glove. He goes by Young Glove.
beats.dlg: PUNCHES TOO FAST TO SEE.|SON OF THE GLOVE!

beats.vo: Spidops. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices. Twice the Pac-12 Defensive Player of the Year at Oregon State.
beats.dlg: IT STRIKES UNNOTICED.|2X PAC-12 DEFENSIVE POY!

beats.vo: Nincada. It lives underground for years in darkness, waiting to evolve. Undrafted, then years in the G League. G League Defensive Player of the Year.
beats.dlg: IT WAITS YEARS TO EVOLVE.|UNDRAFTED. G LEAGUE DPOY.

beats.vo: Garganacl. Its salt heals even severe wounds. In the twenty twenty-two playoffs, he fractured his elbow against Memphis.
beats.dlg: ITS SALT HEALS WOUNDS.|2022: A FRACTURED ELBOW.

beats.vo: Palafin. When its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers up. Back for the Finals. Game five: fifteen points, three steals.
beats.dlg: IT POWERS UP FOR ITS TEAM|FINALS G5: 15 PTS, 3 STL

beats.vo: And the ace. Pawmot. Once the battle starts, it strikes with lightning-fast movements. Undrafted, and a champion with us in twenty twenty-two.
That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Payton II: son of Hall of Famer Gary Payton, known as the Glove; nicknamed GP2 and Young Glove; 2x (2-time) Pac-12 Defensive Player of the Year at Oregon State; undrafted in the 2016 NBA draft; NBA G League Defensive Player of the Year (2021); fractured his left elbow in Game 2 of the 2022 Western Conference semifinals vs Memphis; NBA champion with the Warriors in 2022; in Game 5 of the Finals he posted 15 points and three (3) steals
Hitmonchan: fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see
Spidops: it takes out its prey before the prey even notices it
Nincada lives underground for many years in complete darkness and waits for evolution
Garganacl sprinkles injured Pokemon with salt; even severe wounds promptly heal
Palafin: when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up (ability Zero to Hero)
Pawmot: once it enters battle, it strikes down its enemies with lightning-fast movements
